ارتهطوا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَهَطُوا (irtahaṭū) /ir.ta.ha.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَهَطَ (irtahaṭa)
# اِرْتَهِطُوا (irtahiṭū) /ir.ta.hi.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْتَهَطَ (irtahaṭa)
